field.label: Enable
field.help: Create the aliases, rules and NAT for the profiles below and run the address watcher.

field.label: Client interfaces
field.help: Networks whose clients can be switched, usually LAN. One set of rules is created per interface.

field.label: WAN interfaces
field.help: Traffic of a switched client that would leave through one of these interfaces is blocked (leak protection).

field.label: Watcher interval (seconds)
field.help: How often new addresses of switched clients are picked up, for example new IPv6 privacy addresses.

field.label: Kill states on switch
field.help: Drop open connections of a client when it is switched, so they reconnect through the new gateway at once.

field.label: Enforce skip rules when gateway is down
field.help: Turn on the global "Skip rules when gateway is down" firewall option on apply. Without it a rule whose gateway is down falls back to the default route.

field.label: Log blocked traffic
field.help: Log packets dropped by the kill switch and IPv6 reject rules.
